text:
pagerbot: INCIDENT detected: repeated region fallback loop between us-east <-> us-west <-> eu for model-family 'rdw-chat-v1'. Trigger: health-check flapping on node pools. Auto-alerting oncall.

maya.sre: on call — looking. I'm seeing probe flaps from eu -> us-west -> us-east in the last 6m. Confirming traffic surge? :mag_right:

kevin.eng-runtime: grabbing routing logs now. Initial guess: aggressive fallthrough policy + mixed healthcheck TTLs across regions. Will paste snippets.

ethan.infra-oncall: I'm on standby. If it's a health-check churn we should avoid manual restarts unless needed. We can temporarily disable cross-region fallback in the routing policy to stop the oscillation.

maya.sre: agree. First, impact question: any customer-facing errors or just higher latencies? lia.prod-ops can you pull top-level SLOs?

lia.prod-ops: looking at Frontend -> Redwood API. Error rate increased from 0.06% to 0.7% for requests routed to eu over last 8 minutes. Latency p95 for eu jumped from 150ms -> 420ms. Customers in EU seeing transient 5xx and timeouts. Opening postmortem ticket in #incidents-followup.

jen.support: We got 3 tickets from an EU customer (cloud-analytics) about timeouts on embeddings. Not yet widespread but looks correlated.

kevin.eng-runtime: routing log excerpt (sanitized):

```
2026-03-15T12:03:12Z ROUTER route_id=chanA src=us-east -> dst=eu health=UNHEALTHY fallthrough=enabled
2026-03-15T12:03:13Z ROUTER route_id=chanA src=eu -> dst=us-west health=UNHEALTHY fallthrough=enabled
2026-03-15T12:03:15Z ROUTER route_id=chanA src=us-west -> dst=us-east health=UNHEALTHY fallback_variant=quantized-v2
```

kevin.eng-runtime: healthcheck details from eu-nodepool:

```
probe: /health
up: 540s
fails: 3 (threshold 3) interval: 4s
last_fail_log: TCP timeout to model-kv-cache
```

maya.sre: looks like thresholds are low (3 fails in 4s), combined with short decommission delay the router is quickly falling through. That can create a chain reaction if other regions detect target as unhealthy and fallthrough too.

ethan.infra-oncall: mitigation option A: raise healthcheck tolerance in eu and us-west to 6 fails / 6s, and increase decommission cooldown to 30s so transient glitches don't bounce.

maya.sre: mitigation option B: temporarily disable cross-region fallback for rdw-chat-v1 model-family (keep local failover only) and pin routing to same-region until stability.

kevin.eng-runtime: mitigation option C: force a compatible-but-stable variant in fallback (do not switch to quantized-v2 automatically) — wrong variant switching is causing additional cold-cache latency.

lia.prod-ops: for customer communications, recommend a short note: "We're investigating elevated latencies and timeouts in EU region; intermediate mitigation in progress." Keep it minimal.

maya.sre: decision: apply B + C now. We will disable cross-region fallthrough for rdw-chat-v1 and set fallback_variant to "same-variant-only". If that doesn't stabilize within 10m we'll apply A.

ethan.infra-oncall: applying policy change via infra-console: /routing/policies/rdw-chat-v1 -> set cross_region_fallback=false; set allowed_fallback_variants=["same"]. Patch rolling out now.

pagerbot: ACTION log: policy_update user=ethan.infra-oncall policy=rdw-chat-v1 change=cross_region_fallback=false [link]

kevin.eng-runtime: also pushing a quick patch to routing agent to ignore fallback if healthcheck failure rate is >80% cluster-wide — small guard to avoid cascade loops.

maya.sre: watch dashboards. tia.

(3 minutes later)

kevin.eng-runtime: initial metrics: EU p95 back to 210ms, error rate down to 0.2%. Routing oscillation count dropped from 180->6 in last 4m.

lia.prod-ops: customer tickets: support reply drafted and sent. No major customers escalated to SEs yet. I'll wait 15m before updating status page.

maya.sre: good. Next steps: follow-up items assigned:
- infra: revert cross_region_fallback toggle only after 1h of stable metrics (assigned: ethan.infra-oncall)
- eng-runtime: implement healthcheck hysteresis config across regions (assigned: kevin.eng-runtime)
- prod-ops: notify impacted customers and coordinate postmortem (assigned: lia.prod-ops)

jen.support: I'll collate the support tickets and add to the incident ticket.

pagerbot: INCIDENT resolved: manual mitigation applied. Auto-close check in 60m pending stability.

maya.sre: thanks all. If anything regresses, ping @on-call and we'll escalate. I'll start the incident notes in the followup ticket.

kevin.eng-runtime: note for postmortem: avoid defaulting to different variant families on fallback; prefer same-variant or warmed standby variants.

lia.prod-ops: logging the timeline and customer impact numbers into the followup doc.

jen.support: adding transcript excerpts and affected customer list.

maya.sre: closing thread here; will update once we re-enable cross-region fallback. :white_check_mark:
